data.headline: Careers at StimuliiQ
data.subheadline: Help us build the future of tech education in India. We are a remote-friendly team.

items.title: Senior Python Instructor
items.description: Lead live and recorded Python + Data Science training for cohorts of 20–30 students. 3+ years of industry experience required.

items.title: Career Counsellor
items.description: Guide students through program selection and placement preparation. Strong communication skills + edtech background preferred.

items.title: Full Stack Engineer (NestJS + Next.js)
items.description: Build and maintain our LMS, CRM, and marketing platforms. 2+ years with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
